content.value_statement: Content teams often lack evidence for what to publish next. This skill compares competitor coverage and turns missing opportunities into a prioritized editorial plan.
actual_capabilities: Compares your site coverage with named competitor domains.
Identifies missing keywords, topic clusters, content formats, and journey stages.
Separates quick wins, strategic builds, and long-term opportunities.
Labels evidence as measured, user-provided, estimated, or unavailable.
Creates a prioritized backlog, editorial calendar, and success metrics.
Assesses SEO and generative engine optimization content gaps.
limitations: Requires your site inventory and at least one competitor for a true gap analysis.
Cannot verify search volume, traffic, or rankings without supplied data or connected tools.
Estimated findings require validation before budget or publishing decisions.
Does not replace raw keyword demand research or content production.

use_cases.title: Plan an SEO Backlog
use_cases.description: Compare competitor coverage and rank missing topics by demand, relevance, effort, and competitive density.

use_cases.title: Build an Editorial Calendar
use_cases.description: Turn validated content gaps into a sequenced calendar with formats, owners, dependencies, and success measures.

use_cases.title: Assess Market Coverage
use_cases.description: Find journey, format, and evidence gaps that limit product education and conversion support.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Competitor Comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Find content gaps between [my domain] and [competitor domain]. Focus on [topic] for [audience]. Label every metric by evidence type.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with one competitor and a defined topic.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritized Opportunity List
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [my domain] with [competitor domains]. Rank missing keywords and topics as quick wins, strategic builds, or long-term opportunities.

prompt_templates.title: Format and Journey Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze content format and audience journey gaps across [domains]. Include guides, comparisons, tools, proof, retention content, and GEO opportunities.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Calendar Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these inventories and performance exports: [inputs]. Score gaps, cite competitor evidence, and build a 12-week calendar with owners and success metrics.
prompt_templates.scenario: Convert measured evidence into an execution plan.

output_examples.input: Compare our payroll software blog with two named competitors.
output_examples.output: Quick win: publish a payroll compliance checklist supported by competitor coverage and supplied demand data. Strategic build: create a state-by-state compliance cluster.

output_examples.input: Find missing decision-stage content for our analytics platform.
output: Priority 1: comparison pages for the three most evaluated alternatives.
Priority 2: a documented migration guide with technical requirements.
Priority 3: customer proof organized by industry and use case.

output_examples.input: Create a four-week calendar from validated content gaps.
output_examples.output: Week one addresses the strongest quick win. Weeks two and three build supporting cluster pages. Week four publishes a comparison asset.

best_practices: Provide current site inventories, named competitors, audience details, and business goals.
Attach a source and evidence label to every metric and recommendation.
Validate estimated demand and competitor performance before assigning budget.
anti_patterns: Do not request a competitor-relative gap analysis without competitor or site coverage data.
Do not treat model estimates as measured search or traffic data.
Do not prioritize bare topics without competitor evidence and business relevance.

faq.question: What inputs are required?
faq.answer: Provide your domain or content inventory, one to three competitor domains, the audience, topic scope, and business goals.

faq.question: Does this skill discover raw keyword demand?
faq.answer: No. Use keyword research for demand discovery, then use this skill to compare coverage against competitors.

faq.question: Can it work without SEO tools?
faq.answer: Yes, but metrics may remain user-provided, estimated, or unavailable. Supply exports when measured ranking and traffic data are important.

faq.question: How are opportunities prioritized?
faq.answer: The framework considers demand, competitive coverage, business relevance, creation effort, and conversion potential.

faq.question: What does the final deliverable include?
faq.answer: It includes key findings, a prioritized backlog, an editorial calendar, evidence labels, and success metrics.

faq.question: Does it include GEO analysis?
faq.answer: Yes. It can identify missing definitions, questions, comparisons, evidence, and structures that support AI citation visibility.
